helptext: Ensure that a control parameter is between a lower and upper test value before the transition is started. For instance, require that the 'speed' control parameter is between 0.2 and 0.6

NotInRange.helptext: Flag to negate the condition. If checked, the condition becomes true when the control parameter is not within the specified range.

UpperTestValue.helptext: Upper value of the test to check against.

LowerTestValue.helptext: Lower value of the test to check against.

ControlParameter.helptext: The name of the control parameter to monitor.
